parsed.answer: This has been reported before and is tracked in PowerToys#35808; several similar requests were closed as duplicates of it. The Copilot key is not a single key. It sends the shortcut Win (Left) + Shift (Left) + F23, so it will not appear in the Remap keys dropdown. Open Keyboard Manager > Remap a shortcut, click the pencil, press the Copilot key so it captures the combination, then choose what to send. Some users report this works for sending Ctrl (Left), for example. Known problems: remapping to Ctrl (Right) often ends up sending Ctrl+Shift, and Ctrl+Alt+Del may not work with the remapped key. Shortcut remaps are applied after key remaps, so an existing remap of Win (Left) can interfere with it. One commenter says this is a hardware/firmware limitation, since the key sends three keys. A dedicated Copilot key option in the Remap keys list was declined because that dropdown only lists real virtual keys. The Remap a shortcut approach is the current workaround, and the feature request is still tracked in #35808.
